rules.name: Application build and unresolved imports
rules.description: Component fails to compile, has missing dependencies or imports non-existent files.
rules.repairInstruction: Verify all import statements. Ensure referenced modules, packages, and local files exist and are correctly exported.

rules.name: Broken required interactions
rules.description: Interactive elements (buttons, links, toggles) lack event handlers, onClick callbacks, or valid hrefs.
rules.repairInstruction: Provide functional onClick handlers or valid href targets. If intentionally disabled or static, apply appropriate aria-disabled or presentational roles.

rules.name: Required accessibility gate fails
rules.description: Contrast ratio below WCAG AA (4.5:1 text, 3.0:1 controls), missing image alt attributes, or missing keyboard focus outline.
rules.repairInstruction: Ensure contrast >= 4.5:1. Replace outline:none with visible focus-visible indicators. Add descriptive alt text to all informative images.

rules.name: Horizontal overflow at supported viewports
rules.description: Content exceeds viewport width causing horizontal scrolling on desktop (1440px), tablet (768px), or mobile (375px).
rules.repairInstruction: Constrain wide elements with max-w-full, overflow-x-hidden, or responsive flex/grid layouts. Avoid fixed pixel widths exceeding 320px.

rules.name: Placeholder copy in finished product
rules.description: Detects dummy strings such as 'Lorem ipsum', 'Your Company', 'Feature title', 'John Doe', or unreplaced template copy.
rules.repairInstruction: Replace generic placeholder copy with realistic, context-specific product terminology and human-crafted copy.

rules.name: Generic template repeated without purpose
rules.description: Rigid cookie-cutter sequence (Hero -> 3 identical cards -> Testimonials -> FAQ) without adapting to product narrative.
rules.repairInstruction: Vary section rhythm based on product narrative. Break formulaic layouts with asymmetrical showcases, lists, or interactive demonstrators.

rules.name: Unmotivated default gradient or glow
rules.description: Generic purple-to-blue or cyan radial glow orbs behind heroes signaling AI default styling (R-01).
rules.repairInstruction: Remove generic blurred gradient orbs. Replace with grounded brand colors, subtle ambient lighting, or texture from craft_dna.json.

rules.name: Identical cards repeated with no variation
rules.description: Repetitive cards with identical padding, centered icon layout, and equal visual weight (R-14).
rules.repairInstruction: Introduce visual hierarchy: highlight the flagship feature with expanded media/interactive playground, while secondary items use compact treatments.

rules.name: Raw styling bypasses design tokens
rules.description: Direct hardcoded hex colors (#3b82f6, #000, #fff) or non-standard pixel spacing instead of semantic tokens.
rules.repairInstruction: Refactor raw values to semantic tokens: bg-background, text-foreground, border-border, bg-primary.

rules.name: Excessive glassmorphism or decorative effects
rules.description: Simultaneous backdrop-filter blur on cards, navbar, modals, and sidebar flattening surface depth (R-10).
rules.repairInstruction: Dose-cap glassmorphism to at most 1-2 focal components. Keep primary background and cards solid matte.

rules.name: Inconsistent icon families or emoji icons
rules.description: Using emojis as UI icons or mixing disparate icon sets (e.g., mixing filled, outline, and dual-tone styles randomly).
rules.repairInstruction: Use a cohesive icon library (Iconsax 24x24 single-style) with consistent stroke widths and semantic colors.

rules.name: Uncalibrated linear transition timing
rules.description: Using transition: all 0.3s ease or uncalibrated linear transitions instead of Framer Motion spring physics.
rules.repairInstruction: Replace linear easing with calibrated Framer Motion spring presets (snappy, fluid, editorial) from craft_dna.json.
